---
title: "Current vs Usual"
subtitle: "How do today's buoy conditions compare to the past year?"
author: "USGS / SECOORA ERDDAP"
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: cosmo
    css: styles.css
    nav-buttons:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/usf-imars/fl-bay-usgs-buoy-explorer
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| output: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

source("R/fetch_ndbc_history.R")
source("R/plot_ndbc_context.R")

lookback_days <- 365
recent_days <- 30

history_raw <- fetch_ndbc_network_history(lookback_days = lookback_days)
data_as_of <- fetch_ndbc_erddap_end_time()
data_as_of_label <- format_ndbc_time(data_as_of)
report_time <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z", tz = ndbc_display_tz)

sal_history <- prepare_ndbc_history(history_raw$salinity, "salinity")
temp_history <- prepare_ndbc_history(history_raw$temperature, "temperature")

sal_latest <- latest_ndbc_readings(sal_history, "salinity")
temp_latest <- latest_ndbc_readings(temp_history, "temperature")

sal_summary <- station_context_summary(sal_history, sal_latest, "salinity")
temp_summary <- station_context_summary(temp_history, temp_latest, "temperature")

sal_counts <- network_context_counts(sal_summary)
temp_counts <- network_context_counts(temp_summary)

sal_daily <- network_daily_means(sal_history, "salinity")
temp_daily <- network_daily_means(temp_history, "temperature")

sal_clim <- doy_climatology(sal_history, "salinity")
temp_clim <- doy_climatology(temp_history, "temperature")

example_station <- sal_summary |>
  filter(!is.na(percentile)) |>
  arrange(abs(percentile - 50)) |>
  slice(1)

example_label <- if (nrow(example_station) > 0) {
  example_station$station[1]
} else {
  "Buoy_Key"
}

example_id <- if (nrow(example_station) > 0) {
  example_station$station_id[1]
} else {
  "bkyf1"
}
```

::: {.content-visible when-format="dashboard"}
**Usual** = each buoy's readings over the past **`r lookback_days` days**, compared by **day of year** (10th–90th percentile band). Data from [SECOORA ERDDAP](https://erddap.secoora.org/erddap/index.html). **Report:** `r report_time` · **Latest data:** `r data_as_of_label`
:::

# Overview

## Row

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: High salinity buoys
#| icon: arrow-up-circle
#| color: warning
list(value = sal_counts$n_high)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: Usual salinity buoys
#| icon: check-circle
#| color: success
list(value = sal_counts$n_usual)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: High temperature buoys
#| icon: thermometer-high
#| color: danger
list(value = temp_counts$n_high)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: Usual temperature buoys
#| icon: thermometer-half
#| color: info
list(value = temp_counts$n_usual)
```

## Row {height=40%}

::: {.card title="How to read this dashboard"}
A buoy is **low** when its latest reading falls below the 10th percentile of its own past-year record; **high** when above the 90th percentile; **usual** otherwise. This is not a fixed salinity/temperature threshold — it adapts to each station's history and season.

Distribution plots show the full past-year record (all buoys pooled). Time series show the **network mean** daily value with a band for the usual range on each day of year. Station bars show where today's reading ranks at each buoy (0 = lowest on record, 100 = highest).
:::

# Salinity

## Row {height=55%}

```{r sal-distribution}
#| title: Past-year salinity distribution
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

if (nrow(sal_history) == 0) {
  stop("No salinity history returned from ERDDAP.")
}

plot_context_distribution(
  sal_history,
  sal_latest,
  value_col = "salinity",
  title = "Salinity distribution (past year)",
  unit = "Salinity (PSU)"
)
```

```{r sal-percentiles}
#| title: Latest salinity percentile by buoy
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

plot_station_percentiles(
  sal_summary,
  value_col = "salinity",
  title = "Where today falls in each buoy's history",
  unit = "Salinity (PSU)"
)
```

## Row {height=45%}

```{r sal-network-ts}
#| title: Network mean salinity (30 days)
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

plot_context_timeseries(
  sal_daily,
  sal_clim,
  value_col = "salinity",
  title = "Network daily salinity vs usual",
  unit = "Salinity (PSU)",
  recent_days = recent_days
)
```

```{r sal-station-ts}
#| title: Example buoy time series
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4

plot_station_context_ts(
  sal_history,
  sal_clim,
  station_id = example_id,
  value_col = "salinity",
  title = paste("Daily salinity:", example_label),
  unit = "Salinity (PSU)",
  recent_days = recent_days
)
```
